research_section.intro: This is a good place to describe your research focus, the types of projects you work on, and the impact of your work. You can link to individual research area pages, or add a few lines about each research area here. Explore below cards to availabel options for adding content to your website section.

Fifteen editorial layouts — essay, photo essay, interview, diary, review and more — to copy and edit.
